title: LazyFlash: Forward-Dense, Backward-Sparse Attention for Accelerated Long-Context Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly long sequences, attention becomes a major computational bottleneck. Sparse attention mostly targets inference, yet many methods still train densely or cannot support sparse training, and their added complexity makes sparsity hard to turn into wall-clock speedups, leaving dense attention widely used in practice. This paper introduces LazyFlash, a forward-dense, backward-sparse attention method built on the observation that attention training is dominated by the backward pass. LazyFlash keeps the forward pass exactly dense, so the trained model remains a standard dense model that existing systems such as vLLM can serve without any change. For the backward pass, LazyFlash proposes a gradient-aware block sparsification design that ranks query blocks by their attention-output gradient norms and skips those contributing negligibly to parameter updates, turning the dense backward into a block

translated_title: LazyFlash：前向稠密、后向稀疏的注意力机制，用于加速长上下文微调
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）处理的序列越来越长，注意力机制成为主要的计算瓶颈。稀疏注意力大多针对推理阶段，然而许多方法仍然进行稠密训练或无法支持稀疏训练，且其额外增加的复杂性使得稀疏化难以转化为实际的墙钟时间加速，导致稠密注意力在实践中仍被广泛使用。本文提出了LazyFlash，一种前向稠密、后向稀疏的注意力方法，其建立在一个观察之上：注意力训练的开销主要由反向传播主导。LazyFlash保持前向传播完全稠密，因此训练得到的模型仍然是标准的稠密模型，现有系统（如vLLM）无需任何修改即可直接部署服务。对于反向传播，LazyFlash提出了一种梯度感知的块稀疏化设计，该设计根据注意力输出的梯度范数对查询块进行排序，并跳过那些对参数更新贡献可忽略不计的查询块，从而将稠密的反向传播转化为块稀疏的反向传播。
tldr: LazyFlash利用注意力训练开销主要由反向传播主导这一观察，提出前向保持稠密、后向采用梯度感知块稀疏化的方法，跳过对参数更新贡献可忽略的查询块，在保持模型为标准稠密模型（可被vLLM等系统直接部署）的同时显著加速长上下文微调。
en_tdlr: LazyFlash accelerates long-context fine-tuning by keeping the forward pass exactly dense while applying gradient-aware block sparsification in the backward pass—skipping query blocks that contribute negligibly to parameter updates—thereby producing a standard dense model that existing systems like vLLM can serve without modification.
